notes.title: Bugfixes and Hosting
notes.notes:
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

- Changed Hot Hands to function more similarly to Bad Influence, having a chance to activate instead of always activating.

[h2]Major Bugfixes[/h2]

- Addressed issue where the character controller would occasionally run multiple times per tick, causing players to move much faster than they should.

[h2]Changes to Hosting[/h2]

With all of the new players who joined during next fest, our server hosting costs were starting to get out of control. We've done a ton of optimization on both the client and server to mitigate this.

In the process of optimizing the game to reduce our server costs, we noticed that hosting without a dedicated server (using Steam Networking to host on a player's machine) is now often a better experience than using a dedicated server, especially in later rounds when you the game gets really chaotic.

By default the hosting will now run the server locally, but you can still choose to use a dedicated server in the host settings menu. 

In general, you will have a better experience hosting yourself (without a dedicated server) if you have a reliable internet connection and a decently powerful PC, especially if the people you are playing with are in the same region.


[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

We are aware of some rendering issues related to Auto HDR and Apple Silicon machines, usually manifesting as everything being gray or washed out. We are working on addressing those as soon as possible.

notes.title: Bugfix Patch

- Fixed bug causing burn effect to be invisible while ragdolled

We've also added the ability for the host to kick players from the leaderboard.

Happy Disputing!

Fixes:

- Fixed match counter in lobby not working

notes.title: Performance and Stability Patch
notes.notes:
This patch brings high-quality technical improvements to the game, taking it to the next level of performance, stability, and polish. We've also tweaked the balance of some perks and items to make them more stable and fun to play. Finally, we've made some major improvements to how the game sounds. 

The technical improvements have allowed us to put together our best-looking trailer yet! You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2820700/A_Gentlemens_Dispute/]watch it now on our Steam Page[/url]!

As always, you can leave us feedback and find many distinguished gentlemen seeking to dispute by joining our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/E8BP3yWV2u. 

Thanks for playing! See you disputing soon!
BFG


[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Major Performance and Stability Improvements[/h3][list]
[*] Eliminated network performance loss after spawning many oil splatters.
[*] Reduced graphical impact of oil splatters.
[*] Broadly reduced graphical workload of the game.
[*] Reduced cost of rendering many bear traps and mines.
[*] Eliminated slight jitter of character at high frame rates.
[*] Fixed various bugs related to C4 positioning.[/list]
[h3]Perk Balance[/h3][list]
[*] Decreased rate of increase for doubling cannons and traps after a certain point. The number has no cap but it will stop doubling and start increasing linearly after a certain point.[/list]
[h3]Item Balance[/h3][list]
[*] Increased size of hitbox for the Bat.
[*] Bat will only be consumed after three misses. Always consumed after a hit.
[*] Increased speed and size of hitbox for the Spin Kick.
[*] Fixed issue causing very slow item spawning if only rare items are selected in the game settings.[/list]
[h3]Sound Improvements[/h3][list]
[*] Major improvements to spatialization (where things sound like they are coming from).
[*] Several new and improved sound effects.
[*] Fixed issue relating to sound reverb not being affected by volume sliders in settings.[/list]

notes.title: The Chaos Update Has Been Released!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Everyone! A major update has just been released![/h2]

[u]See the full list of changes at the bottom of this announcement. [/u]

While we made a ton of technical and visual improvements in the major update last month, there were a few aspects that felt like a bit of a step back, and that mainly manifested in the feedback that the game had slowed down.

This update is designed to address that, and restore some of the [u]chaos, speed, and insanity of the original demo version[/u]. Perhaps even going... further beyond...

[h3]What's New?[/h3]
We've eliminated the windup times for the jetpack, shotgun, and rocket launcher. We've restored the shark Rufus back to his former ever-present self, biting you as soon as you get too deep in the water. We've removed the caps on Extra Traps and Bigger Traps.

We've permanently included the C4 and Jetpack in the demo and [b]added two new items[/b] that were previously locked, the Champagne Bottle and the Airstrike.

The biggest change is [b]a complete rework of the leap mechanic[/b]. The new leaping is much more controllable and no longer turns you into a ragdoll. We've had a ton of fun working on this change and we hope you enjoy it as much as we did. We're looking forward to your feedback on this change since its probably the biggest gameplay change we've made since the demo was first made public.

There are also a ton of technical, sound, and performance improvements included in this update.

[h3]Community Events & What's Next[/h3]
[u]This Saturday at 4pm EST will be holding an event with the whole dev team in our discord to play with everyone here and hear your feedback on the latest update.[/u] Join the server here: https://discord.gg/E8BP3yWV2u

This is the last update before our first major content update, coming very soon, which will include [b]five new items[/b] and [b]several new perks[/b]. We'll start showing sneak previews of this content next week!

Finally, with a ton new content coming down the road for AGD, we are looking to form a group of [b]official playtesters[/b] who we will invite to regular playtests of prerelease content and get direct feedback from. If you are interested in signing up, please fill out this google form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeVSwkU2QCRQoNr_LMi2CfXEZX0Tv0fPZWAtqEr0oAWKVi41w/viewform. 

Thanks for playing! See you disputing soon!
BFG


[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Major Changes[/h3][list]
[*] Major improvements to netcode and performance. Character movement should be noticeably smoother and more consistent even under bad network conditions.
[*] Eliminated the windup time for the shotgun, rocket launcher, and jetpack.
[*] Made all new items permanently available in the demo, including the new Champagne Bottle and Airstrike items.
[*] Restored old shark behavior on the island level.
[*] Completely reworked leap to be a controllable arc instead of launching the character as a ragdoll. Players can also hold down the leap input to stay in a charged squat position before leaping.
[*] Eliminated brief invincibility window after taking damage. Multiple consecutive explosions will now deal stacked damage. Added damage falloff if taken from the same item in rapid succession.[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3][list]
[*] Slightly increased the hitbox of the Bat. 
[*] Slightly increased the hitbox of the Spin Kick. 
[*] Removed Extra Bullets perk.
[*] Removed caps for Extra Traps and Bigger Traps perks.
[*] Ghosts can no longer directly collide with players.[/list]
[h3]Sound[/h3][list]
[*] Addressed major issue causing volume of all sounds to inconsistent.
[*] Major improvements to destruction sounds.
[*] Various improvements to sounds and mixing.[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3][list]
[*] Smoothed slow-motion final kill camera. 
[*] Removed ability to move cards in perk selection. 
[*] Added indicator to leave cannon. 
[*] Added notification when item is stolen. 
[*] Added loading screen text. 
[*] Improved damage number text. 
[*] Reduced size of perk HUD. [/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed bug where jetpack model and visual effect would remain after being damaged. 
[*] Fixed bug where shotgun visual effect would trigger when perk HUD activated. 
[*] Fixed bug where Bad Influence and Item Thief would take effect on non-melee items. 
[*] Fixed bug where using a C4 could delete a second C4 from the inventory. 
[*] Fixed bug where ghosts would not spawn. 
[*] Fixed bug where loading would occasionally take much longer than necessary.
[*] Fixed bug where loading screen would fade too early.
[*] Fixed bug where SFX slider would not effect certain sound effects.[/list]

notes.title: Major Update Out Today!
notes.notes:
[h3]Salutations My Good Sirs![/h3]
I'm thrilled to proclaim a major update for A Gentlemen’s Dispute’s free demo has arrived today! It brings fame, fortune, and…

[h3]Items[/h3]
A limited time preview of [b]two never-before-seen items[/b]. Play while they’re available in the free demo!
[list]
[*] [b]The Jetpack[/b] lets players rocket away from danger, then take pot-shots from the sky. Combine with the rocket launcher for a devastating combo!
[*] [b]The C4[/b] is a tricky, sticky, remote-detonated explosive. Plant as many as you can, then blow your opponents sky-high!
[/list]
[h3]Perks[/h3]
Five [b]brand-new perks[/b]!
[list]
[*] [b]Grenadier[/b] lobs additional bombs, adding chaos to the fray.
[*] [b]Chef[/b] cooks up delicious dinners to celebrate every victory. Feast upon your fallen foes to reclaim your lost health!
[*] [b]Charlatan[/b] confuses with devilish dancing illusions.
[*] [b]Bad Influence[/b] leaps into enemies to make them drunk and dizzy!
[*] Pick [b]Dealer’s Choice[/b] to receive a random perk from the deck!
[/list]
[h3]And More![/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fully overhauled physics[/b], now with new ragdolls and slippery-smooth netcode.
[*] New, [b]entirely overhauled visuals[/b] for characters, perks, items, lobbies, perk selection, and three exquisite stages.
[list][*] Play the day away in the all-new [b]Nighttime Gardens[/b]!
[*] Perks have been repackaged as an illustrated deck of cards. Which ones will you add to your hand?
[/list][*] A slew of [b]new and improved sounds[/b].
[*] An all-new [b]start screen[/b] allowing you to customize the items, stages, and perks included in each dispute.
[*] An [b]all-new HUD showcasing your perks[/b] in as they take effect in real time.
[*] [b]Controllable cannons[/b]! Enjoy aiming them at your enemies and destroying them with ease.
[/list]
Each gentle-developer on the AGD team cooked out of their [i]gourds[/i] to bring this update to life. I’m quite simply flabbergasted by their efforts and the fruits of their labors. We hope you enjoy disputing with what we’ve been up to! 

Play [i][b]A Gentlemen’s Dispute[/b][/i]'s free demo today! 

Happy disputing! 
BFG

notes.title: Update! Online Matchmaking Arrives! New Perks and Hats!
notes.notes:
[h2]Good Day, Fellow Gentlemen![/h2]

We’re excited to release our next update! 

Not only has our [b]Lead Gentle-Engineer Thomas[/b] brought us yet another [b]Bounty of Bugfixes[/b], but he’s made disputing a whole lot smoother with [b]Quality of Life Updates[/b] including gameplay settings, public online matchmaking, and more improvements to online lobbies. See the full list of changes below. 

[h3]Hark! The Explosive Bowtie Returns[/h3]
It’s back and better than ever! Select this perk and upon taking damage, you’ll drop bombs at the feet of your enemies. Stack this perk for maximum martyrdom!

[h1]Changelist[/h1]
[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Online[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a public lobby list. Hosts can set their lobby to be publicly joinable in the bottom by clicking “Make Lobby Public.” Your friend’s lobbies will always appear in the lobby list.
[*]Added an easy “Invite” button for inviting Steam friends to your lobby.
[*]Improved consistency of joining mid-game.
[*]Host can now kick players from the leaderboard menu.
[*]Added rich presence support to show your friends which map you’re disputing on.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay Settings[/h3]
[list]
[*]Host can now set the number of rounds required to win. We don’t recommend going above 10 rounds. But feel free to nuke your computer with 2^32 traps on round 67.
[*]Host can now restart games from the pause menu at any time, including after finishing a game! Meaning the host can now restart without going back to the lobby.
[*]Added a leaderboard (Tab / Select) showing wins and perks for each player. Hover over other players to view their perks.
[*]Players joining mid-game will always join as ghosts.
[*]Character customizations will be saved between online sessions.
[*]Multiple players can now play with the same color outfit in the same game. Make your own team matches!
[*]Added UI to show how many extra uses of an item you have.

notes.title: Update! Online Luxuries, Translation, and a Wealth of Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Tally-ho! 

A wave of updates brings quality-of-life improvements and bugfixes to online disputes. What's more, the gentlemen are now bilingual! This update also introduces Chinese language support!  

[h3]Major Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Players can now join other players through Steam from outside the game. 
[*]Players are now able to join mid-game. Players who join late in the round will join as ghosts. 
[*]Returning to menu as host now returns everyone to the lobby instead of ending the game.
[*]Increased server tick rate from 30 to 60. 
[*]Added language setting in options menu and support for Chinese language!
[*]Added a timer to limit the duration of perk selection. If time runs out, players that haven't picked a perk will receive a random perk. 
[*]Removed explosive bow-tie perk. 
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed various issues related to joining lobbies. 
[*]Fixed players not being able to leave online lobbies. 
[*]Fixed issue with pause menu not working on keyboard. 
[*]Fixed cursor not being freed when options menu is opened. 
[*]Fixed options menu being blank until selecting a tab. 
[*]Fixed bug allowing multiple people to grab the same perk. 
[*]Addressed several cases of users getting stuck in a damaged state. 
[*]Addressed issue causing players to be stuck in leaping animation until they ragdolled. 
[/list]

Thanks for playing! We're excited to continue bringing you updates. The next will be filled with all manner of items, perks, and props. [url=https://discord.gg/E8BP3yWV2u]Join the discord server to make suggestions! [/url] It's also a great place to find fellow gentlemen eager to start disputes.

Until next! Continue disputing! 
BFG
